blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: After conditioning with RAW SHEA BUTTER DEEP MOISTURIZING CONDITIONER or MASQUE, apply product to clean, damp hair and comb through. Do not rinse. Air dry ar diffuse. Perfect for your twist-out, braid out, or wash n' go styles.

blocks.label: Warnings
